newsitem.title: FRANCE: Policeman killed, four hurt in France shooting.
newsitem.headline: Policeman killed, four hurt in France shooting.

text.p: A French policeman was shot dead and four other people were injured in a shootout after a car chase in the central city of Lyon, police said on Thursday.

A man driving a stolen car the wrong way down a one-way street started shooting at random as police closed in, they said. A 36-year-old policeman was shot dead and another policeman and two passers-by were injured. The driver was wounded in a gunbattle and arrested.
